A '''Bothan pilot''' was a member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] was killed in the course of a secret mission and later replaced with [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]].
